newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Oceana buys Federal Marine for 43.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Oceana buys Federal Marine for 43.5 mln.

text.p: Oceana Fishing Group Ltd bought Federal Marine Ltd for 43.5 million rand, vice chairman Robbie Williams said on Thursday.
He told the group's annual general meeting that Federal Marine's shareholders, including Ocfish Holding Company, "had for some time been considering the unbundling of the company.
"Disposing of trademarks owned by Federal Marine was one issue to be resolved in the process."
Oceana successfully bid for the business, which included the Lucky Star, Seafare, Lucky Pet, Prize Pet and Happy Pet trademarks.

Williams said the investment was effective from January 1 this year "with a proviso...that the affairs of Federal Marine will continue to be conducted in the same traditional manner until December 31, 1997, at which time payment is to be made."
He said the group had performed well in the first quarter of the current year, with overall results ahead of budget.
